<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A box contains bags of crisps.

Each bag of crisps weighs $25 \ \text{grams}$.

Altogether, the bags of crisps inside weigh $1 \ \text{kg}$.

How many bags of crisps are inside the box?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A box contains bags of crisps.
<emptyline>
Each bag of crisps weighs $25 \ \text{grams}$.
<emptyline>
Altogether, the bags of crisps inside weigh $1 \ \text{kg}$.
<emptyline>
How many bags of crisps are inside the box?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of bags of crisps $= b$

The weight of box is given in kg and weight of crisp bag is given in grams. Lets convert weight of box in grams.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total weight of the bags}         &= 1 \ \text{kg} \\\\
                                        &= 1 \times 1000 \ \text{grams} \\\\
                                        &= 1000 \ \text{grams}
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
b \times 25                 &= 1000 \\\\
b                           &= \dfrac {1000} {25} \\\\
b                           &= \dfrac {25 \times 40} {25} \\\\
b                           &= \dfrac {\cancel {25} \times 40} {\cancel {25}} \\\\
b                           &= 40
\end{aligned}
$

Number of bags of crisps inside the box $= 40$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$40$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mel has 27 marbles. She gives $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of them to Vix 
and a half of the rest to Sarah. How many are left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mel has 27 marbles. She gives $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of them to Vix 
and a half of the rest to Sarah. How many are left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Marbles left}            &=  \text {Total Marbles} -  \text {Marbles Vix got} - \text {Marbles Sarah got} \\\\
                                &=  27 -  \dfrac {1} {3} \times 27 - \dfrac {1} {4} \times 180 \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 180} {5}  - \dfrac {180} {4}  \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 36 \times 5} {5}  - \dfrac {45 \times 4} {4}  \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 36 \times \cancel{5}} {\cancel{5}}  - \dfrac{45 \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4}}  \\\\
                                &=  180 -  2 \times 36 - 45  \\\\
                                &=  180 -  72 - 45  \\\\
                                &=  63
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

                                &=  27 -  \dfrac {1} {3} \times 27 - \dfrac {1} {4} \times 180 \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 180} {5}  - \dfrac {180} {4}  \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 36 \times 5} {5}  - \dfrac {45 \times 4} {4}  \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 36 \times \cancel{5}} {\cancel{5}}  - \dfrac{45 \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4}}  \\\\

$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Small egg boxes can hold six eggs. How many egg boxes are needed to hold $50$ eggs?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Small egg boxes can hold six eggs. How many egg boxes are needed to hold $50$ eggs?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of egg boxes needed $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 6                          &= 50 \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {50} {6} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {25 \times 2} {3 \times 2} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {25 \times \cancel 2} {3 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {25} {3} \\\\
a                                   &= 8 \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
a                                   &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

Number of egg boxes needed $= 9$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the number of egg boxes needed $= a$
<emptyline>
As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 6                          &= 50 \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {50} {6} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {25 \times 2} {3 \times 2} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {25 \times \cancel 2} {3 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {25} {3} \\\\
a                                   &= 8 \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
a                                   &= 9
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Number of egg boxes needed $= 9$.
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Lisa has some boxes that are all cubes of the same size.

She uses four of the boxes to make a pile with a height of $72 \ \text{cm}$.

She puts one more box on top of the pile.

![papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-2/s02-q14-i00.png](/assets/papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-2/s02-q14-i00.png "papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-2/s02-q14-i00.png")

Work out the height of the pile of **five** boxes.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Lisa has some boxes that are all cubes of the same size.
<emptyline>
She uses four of the boxes to make a pile with a height of $72 \ \text{cm}$.
<emptyline>
She puts one more box on top of the pile.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
Work out the height of the pile of **five** boxes.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Height of the pile of 5 boxes}            &= 5 \times \dfrac {72} {4} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {5 \times 72} {4} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {5 \times 18 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {5 \times 18 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 4} \\\\
                                                &= 5 \times 18 \\\\
                                                &= 90 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

**Question**

An icicle measured $2.14 \ \text{m}$ at the start of a sunny day, but only $87 \ \text{cm}$ at the end of the day. What length of icicle had melted?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">An icicle measured $2.14 \ \text{m}$ at the start of a sunny day, but only $87 \ \text{cm}$ at the end of the day. What length of icicle had melted?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Length of icicle at start of the day}         &= 2.14 \ \text{m} \\\\
                                                    &= 2.14 \times 100 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                                                    &= 214 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Length of icicle melted}          &= 214 - 87 \\\\
                                        &= 127 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$127 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of bags}               &= \dfrac {290} {12} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {145 \times 2} {6 \times 2} \\\\

                                    &= \dfrac {145} {6} \\\\
                                    &= 24 \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
                                    &= 25
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$25$

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of raspberry creams}       &= 30 \times 3 \\\\
                                        &= 90 \\\\
\text{Number of pineapple jellies}      &= 30 \times 1 \\\\
                                        &= 30 \\\\
\text{Number of lemon sours}            &= 30 \times 2 \\\\
                                        &= 60
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of raspberry creams packets}       &= \dfrac {90} {15} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {15 \times 6} {15} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {15} \times 6} {\cancel {15}} \\\\
                                                &= 6 \\\\
\text{Number of pineapple jellies packets}      &= \dfrac {30} {10} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {3 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                                &= 3 \\\\
\text{Number of lemon sours packets}            &= \dfrac {60} {20} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {20 \times 3} {20} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {20} \times 3} {\cancel {20}} \\\\
                                                &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Raspberry creams packets $= 6$

Pineapple jellies packets $= 3$

Lemon sours packets $= 3$

**Question**

How long, in metres, is a line of forty $10 \ \text{p}$ coins?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How long, in metres, is a line of forty $10 \ \text{p}$ coins?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Length of forty 10p coins}   &= 40 \times 25 \ \text {mm} \\\\
                                   &= 40 \times \dfrac {25} {1000} \ \text{m} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {40 \times 25} {1000} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {40 \times 25} {40 \times 25} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {\cancel {40} \times \cancel {25}} {\cancel {40} \times \cancel {25}} \\\\
                                   &= 1 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1 \ \text{m}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Aidan can buy wine for his shop in two ways. 

Firstly, he can buy cases which each contain $12$ bottles of wine. Each case costs $\pounds 40$. 

Secondly, he can buy single bottles of wine at a cost of $\pounds 4.50$ each. For every $6$ bottles he buys, he gets $2$ extra bottles free.

Aidan decides he needs $96$ bottles of wine. Work out the cost by each of the two methods and then say which method is cheaper, and by how much. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Aidan can buy wine for his shop in two ways. 
<emptyline>
Firstly, he can buy cases which each contain $12$ bottles of wine. Each case costs $\pounds 40$. 
<emptyline>
Secondly, he can buy single bottles of wine at a cost of $\pounds 4.50$ each. For every $6$ bottles he buys, he gets $2$ extra bottles free.
<emptyline>
Aidan decides he needs $96$ bottles of wine. Work out the cost by each of the two methods and then say which method is cheaper, and by how much. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total cost of cases  $= a$

Let the cost of individual bottles $= b$

Number of cases Adian have to buy $= \dfrac{96}{12}$

Number of individual bottles Adian have to buy $= \dfrac{96}{8} \times 6$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a &= \dfrac{96}{12} \times 40 \\\\
a &= \dfrac{12 \times 8}{12} \times 40 \\\\
a &= \dfrac{\cancel {12} \times 8}{\cancel {12}} \times 40 \\\\
a &= 8 \times 40 \\\\
a &= \pounds 320
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
b &= \dfrac{96}{8} \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= \dfrac{12 \times 8}{8} \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= \dfrac{\cancel 8 \times 12}{\cancel 8} \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= 12 \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= \pounds 324
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Therefore first method is cheaper by} &= \pounds 324 - \pounds 320 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 4
\end{aligned}
$ 
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 320, \pounds 324, \pounds 4$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock_title">

<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>

a &= \dfrac{\cancel {12} \times 8}{\cancel {12}} \times 40 \\\\
a &= 8 \times 40 \\\\
a &= \pounds 320
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
b &= \dfrac{96}{8} \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= \dfrac{12 \times 8}{8} \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= \dfrac{\cancel 8 \times 12}{\cancel 8} \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= 12 \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= \pounds 324
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Therefore first method is cheaper by} &= \pounds 324 - \pounds 320 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 4
\end{aligned}
$ 
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Cheadle Construction uses metal beams, like the one below, in buildings to support walls and ceilings.

![papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i00.png "papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i00.png")

The beams can be placed in one of two ways so the end of the beam is in either Position $1$ or Position $2$.

![papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i01.png](/assets/papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i01.png "papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i01.png")

![papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i02.png](/assets/papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i02.png "papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i02.png")

The height and width of a beam (in $\text{cms}$) determines the size of the greatest load (in $\text{kgs}$) the beam can support, according to the following formula

$\bold { \textbf{Load} = 10 \times \textbf{height} \times \textbf{height} \times \textbf{width} }$

So if the height is $4 \ \text{cm}$ and the width is $6 \ \text{cm}$, the greatest load is given by

$L = 10 \times 4 \times 4 \times 6 = 960 \ \text{kg}$

</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The weight of a wall means that a beam in the wall is needed to support a load of $4860 \ \text{kg}$.

If the width of the beam had to be $6 \ \text{cm}$, what height of beam would a builder have to use?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The weight of a wall means that a beam in the wall is needed to support a load of $4860 \ \text{kg}$.
<emptyline>
If the width of the beam had to be $6 \ \text{cm}$, what height of beam would a builder have to use?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the height of the beam $= h$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
10 \times h \times h \times 6      &= 4860 \\\\
10 \times 6 \times h ^ 2           &= 4860 \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= \dfrac {4860} {10 \times 6} \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= \dfrac {10 \times 6 \times 81} {10 \times 6} \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= \dfrac {\cancel {10} \times \cancel 6 \times 81} {\cancel {10} \times \cancel 6} \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= 81 \\\\
h                                  &= \sqrt {81} \\\\
h                                  &= 9 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">

<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the height of the beam $= h$
<emptyline>
As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
10 \times h \times h \times 6      &= 4860 \\\\
10 \times 6 \times h ^ 2           &= 4860 \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= \dfrac {4860} {10 \times 6} \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= \dfrac {10 \times 6 \times 81} {10 \times 6} \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= \dfrac {\cancel {10} \times \cancel 6 \times 81} {\cancel {10} \times \cancel 6} \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= 81 \\\\
h                                  &= \sqrt {81} \\\\
h                                  &= 9 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ollie is making some small snacks for a party. He cuts 
$1.2 \ \text{kg}$ of cheese into a number 
of $15 \ \text{g}$ pieces.  How many pieces does he have?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ollie is making some small snacks for a party. He cuts 
$1.2 \ \text{kg}$ of cheese into a number 
of $15 \ \text{g}$ pieces.  How many pieces does he have?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of pieces}     &= \dfrac {1.2 \ \text{kg}} {15 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {1.2 \times 1000 \ \text{g}} {15 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {1200} {15} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {80 \times 15} {15} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {80 \times \cancel{15}} {\cancel{15}} \\\\
                            &= 80
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$80$

</div>
</div>

                                                       &= 38 \ \text{mins}
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

The second group has $76$ people in it. How many four seater cars will they need if they take $5$ sports cars and $7$ people carriers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The second group has $76$ people in it. How many four seater cars will they need if they take $5$ sports cars and $7$ people carriers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of four seater cars needed $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 4 + 5 \times 2 + 7 \times 6         &= 76 \\\\
4a + 10 + 42                                 &= 76 \\\\
4a + 52                                      &= 76 \\\\
4a                                           &= 76 - 52 \\\\
4a                                           &= 24 \\\\
a                                            &= \dfrac {24} {4} \\\\
a                                            &= \dfrac {4 \times 6} {4} \\\\
a                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 6} {\cancel 4} \\\\
a                                            &= 6
\end{aligned}
$

Number of four seater cars needed $= 6$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6$

4a + 52                                      &= 76 \\\\
4a                                           &= 76 - 52 \\\\
4a                                           &= 24 \\\\
a                                            &= \dfrac {24} {4} \\\\
a                                            &= \dfrac {4 \times 6} {4} \\\\
a                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 6} {\cancel 4} \\\\
a                                            &= 6
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Number of four seater cars needed $= 6$
</code></pre>
</div>

**Question**

In the fourth group there are $66$ people. 
They need twice as many sports cars as four seater cars and twice as many four seater cars as people carriers.  
How many four seater cars do they use?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the fourth group there are $66$ people. 
They need twice as many sports cars as four seater cars and twice as many four seater cars as people carriers.  
How many four seater cars do they use?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of people carriers needed $= a$

Number of four seater cars needed $= 2a$

Number of sports cars needed $= 4a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2a \times 4 + 4a \times 2 + a \times 6      &= 66 \\\\
8a + 8a + 6a                                &= 66 \\\\
22a                                         &= 66 \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {66} {22} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {22 \times 3} {22} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {\cancel {22} \times 3} {\cancel {22}} \\\\
a                                           &= 3
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of four seater cars used}            &= 2 \times a \\\\
                                                  &= 2 \times 3 \\\\
                                                  &= 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$6$

200 \ \text {sheets}                                   & \ratio 1.6 \ \text{cm}                                               \\\\
200 \ \text {sheets}                                   & \ratio 1.6 \times 10 \ \text {mm}                                     \\\\
200 \ \text {sheets}                                   & \ratio 16                                                             \\\\
\dfrac {200 \text { sheets}} {200}                     & \ratio \dfrac {16}{200}                                               \\\\
\dfrac {\cancel {200} \text { sheets}} {\cancel {200}} & \ratio \dfrac {16}{200} \ \text {mm}                                  \\\\
1 \text { sheet}                                       & \ratio \dfrac {2 \times 8}{2 \times 100}  \ \text {mm}                \\\\
1 \text { sheet}                                       & \ratio \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 8}{\cancel 2 \times 100} \ \text{cm} \\\\
1 \text { sheet}                                       & \ratio \dfrac {8}{100} \ \text {mm}                                   \\\\
1 \ \text {sheet}                                      & \ratio 0.008 \ \text {mm}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

&= 20 \ \text{teachers}
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

$20\%$ of those who were given socks also received a tie. How many were given socks and a tie?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

\begin{aligned}
&= 20 \% \ \text{of} \ 20 \  \text {teachers} \\\\
&= \dfrac {20} {100} \times 20 \\\\
&= \dfrac {20 \times 20} {100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} {2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\

&= 2 \times 2 \\\\
&= 4 \ \text {teachers}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

![papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q12-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q12-i00.png "papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q12-i00.png")  

Biscuits are sold in packets of $12$.

How many packets will I need to buy if I want $148$ biscuits?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%image%  
<emptyline>
Biscuits are sold in packets of $12$.
<emptyline>
How many packets will I need to buy if I want $148$ biscuits?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of packets needed to buy}       &= \dfrac {\text{Total number of biscuits}} {\text{Number of biscuits in each packet}} \\\\
                                             &= \dfrac {148} {12} \\\\
                                             &= 12 \text{ remainder } 4 \\\\
                                             &\approx 13
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{Biscuits}                   &:& \text{Packets} \\\\
= & 12                                &:& 1 \\\\
= & 1                                 &:& \dfrac {1} {12} \\\\
= & 1 \times 148                      &:& \dfrac {148} {12} \\\\
= & 148                               &:& 12 \text{ remainder } 4 \\\\
= & 148                               &:& \approx 13
\end{array}
$

Number of packets needed to buy $= 13$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$13 \ \text{packets}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Concert tickets for $4$ adults cost a total of $\pounds 62.$        

Children are admitted at half price.

What would it cost for $2$ adults and a child to attend the same concert?

![papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q21-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q21-i00.png "papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q21-i00.png")


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Concert tickets for $4$ adults cost a total of $\pounds 62.$        
<emptyline>
Children are admitted at half price.
<emptyline>
What would it cost for $2$ adults and a child to attend the same concert?
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of one adult} &= \dfrac {62} {4} \\\\
\text{Cost of one child} &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {62} {4} \\\\
\text{Total cost}        &= 2 \times \dfrac {62} {4} + \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {62} {4}\\\\
                         &= \dfrac {2 \times 62} {4} + \dfrac {62} {2 \times 4} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {2 \times 2 \times 31} {2 \times 2} + \dfrac {2 \times 31} {2 \times 4} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times 31} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2} + \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 31} {\cancel 2 \times 4} \\\\
                         &= 31 + \dfrac {31} {4} \\\\
                         &= 31 + 7.75 \\\\
                         &= \pounds 38.75 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 38.75$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>

</code></pre>

</div>

</code></pre>
</div>

<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of one adult} &= \dfrac {62} {4} \\\\
\text{Cost of one child} &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {62} {4} \\\\
\text{Total cost}        &= 2 \times \dfrac {62} {4} + \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {62} {4}\\\\
                         &= \dfrac {2 \times 62} {4} + \dfrac {62} {2 \times 4} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {2 \times 2 \times 31} {2 \times 2} + \dfrac {2 \times 31} {2 \times 4} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times 31} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2} + \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 31} {\cancel 2 \times 4} \\\\
                         &= 31 + \dfrac {31} {4} \\\\
                         &= 31 + 7.75 \\\\
                         &= \pounds 38.75 
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Homer, Marge and Bart each have $1000$.

Homer gives $10\%$ of his money to Marge. Marge then gives $10\%$ of her new amount to Bart. Bart then gives $10\%$ of his new amount to Homer.

How much has Homer got now?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Homer, Marge and Bart each have $1000$.
<emptyline>
Homer gives $10\%$ of his money to Marge. Marge then gives $10\%$ of her new amount to Bart. Bart then gives $10\%$ of his new amount to Homer.
<emptyline>
How much has Homer got now?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Amount Homer gives to Marge}          &= 10 \% \ \text{of} \ 1000 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10} {100} \times 1000 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10 \times 1000} {100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10 \times 10 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 10 \times 10 \\\\
                                            &= 100 \\\\
\text{Amount Homer is left with}            &= 1000 - 100\\\\ 
                                            &= 900 \\\\                                           
\text{New amount that Marge has}            &= 1000 + 100 \\\\   
                                            &= 1100 \\\\                                        
\text{Amount Marge gives to Bart}           &= 10 \% \ \text{of} \ 1100 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10} {100} \times 1100 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10 \times 1100} {100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10 \times 11 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 10 \times 11 \\\\
                                            &= 110 \\\\
\text{New amount that Bart has}             &= 1000 + 110 \\\\   
                                            &= 1110 \\\\                                        
\text{Amount Bart gives to Homer}           &= 10 \% \ \text{of} \ 1110 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10} {100} \times 1110 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10 \times 1110} {100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {1 \cancel 0 \times 111 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 1 \times 111 \\\\
                                            &= 111 \\\\
\text{New amount that Homer has}            &= 900 + 111 \\\\   
                                            &= 1011
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1011$

</div>
</div>

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken to cook}     &= 3 \dfrac {1} {2} \times 30 + 20 \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {7} {2} \times 30 + 20 \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {7 \times 30} {2} + 20 \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {7 \times 2 \times 15} {2} + 20 \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel 2 \times 15} {\cancel 2} + 20 \\\\
                              &= 7 \times 15 + 20 \\\\
                              &= 105 + 20 \\\\
                              &= 125 \ \text{mins}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Three gear wheels turn one another. $X$ has $8$ teeth, $Y$ has $12$ teeth and $Z$ has $16$ teeth. In one minute, $X$ turns $30$ times. In this time, how many turns do $Y$ and $Z$ make? Draw arrows to show the directions in which $Y$ and $Z$ move.


![papers/whitgift-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q08-i00.png](/assets/papers/whitgift-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q08-i00.png "papers/whitgift-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q08-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Three gear wheels turn one another. $X$ has $8$ teeth, $Y$ has $12$ teeth and $Z$ has $16$ teeth. In one minute, $X$ turns $30$ times. In this time, how many turns do $Y$ and $Z$ make? Draw arrows to show the directions in which $Y$ and $Z$ move.
<emptyline>

%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of turn Y make}  &= \dfrac {8 \times 30} {12} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {4 \times 2 \times 3 \times 10} {4 \times 3} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 2 \times \cancel 3 \times 10} {\cancel 4 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
                              &= 2 \times 10 \\\\
                              &= 20 \\\\
\text{Number of turn Z make}  &= \dfrac {8 \times 30} {16} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {4 \times 2 \times 3 \times 2 \times 5} {4 \times 2 \times 2} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times \cancel 2 \times 3 \times \cancel 2 \times 5} {\cancel 4 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
                              &= 3 \times 5 \\\\
                              &= 15
\end{aligned}
$

Y revolves in the opposite direction to X.

Z revolves in the same direction as X.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20 ,15$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

**Cough mixture**

A bottle contains $250\,\text{ml}$ of cough mixture.

**One adult** and **one child** need to take cough mixture **$4$ times a day** every day for **$5$ days**. 

Will there be enough cough mixture in the bottle? 

Explain your answer.

![papers/woldingham-school/2014/sample-paper-1/s02-q04-i00.png](/assets/papers/woldingham-school/2014/sample-paper-1/s02-q04-i00.png "papers/woldingham-school/2014/sample-paper-1/s02-q04-i00.png")

**Question**

Dave the minion has been given $161$ presents. How long would it take him to deliver these?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Dave the minion has been given $161$ presents. How long would it take him to deliver these?
</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time required}        &= \dfrac {161} {7} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {7 \times 23} {7} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 7 \times 23} {\cancel 7} \\\\
                            &= 23 \ \text{hours}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$23 \ \text{hours}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I roll a bouncy ball down the stairs. It bounces once after $2$ steps, then again after double the number of steps. 
It carries on falling, bouncing after triple the number of steps it had bounced originally. 
At this point how many steps lower is the ball than where it started?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I roll a bouncy ball down the stairs. It bounces once after $2$ steps, then again after double the number of steps. 
It carries on falling, bouncing after triple the number of steps it had bounced originally. 
At this point how many steps lower is the ball than where it started?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of steps before 1st bounce}        &= 2 \\\\
\text{Number of steps before 2nd bounce}        &= 2 \times 2 \\\\
                                                &= 4 \\\\
\text{Number of steps before 3rd bounce}        &= 2 \times 3 \\\\
                                                &= 6
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total number of steps}        &= 2 + 4 + 6 \\\\
                                    &= 12
\end{aligned}
$

Number of steps the ball lowered after it started rolling $= 12$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$12$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mr Rich decided to share his wealth among his children. 

Richie as the oldest got $\dfrac{1}{3}$, 
Thrifty the second oldest got a $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of what was left, 
Bounty got $\dfrac{1}{2}$ of what was left once Richie and Thrifty got their share. 
The dog, Archie, got the rest. 

If Mr Rich shared $\pounds 9$ million pounds, how much did Archie get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mr Rich decided to share his wealth among his children. 
<emptyline>
Richie as the oldest got $\dfrac{1}{3}$, 
Thrifty the second oldest got a $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of what was left, 
Bounty got $\dfrac{1}{2}$ of what was left once Richie and Thrifty got their share. 
The dog, Archie, got the rest. 
<emptyline>
If Mr Rich shared $\pounds 9$ million pounds, how much did Archie get?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Archie's share of wealth}     &= \pounds \dfrac {1} {2} \times \left( \dfrac {2} {3} \times \left( \dfrac {2} {3} \times 9000000 \right) \right) \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {2} {3} \times \dfrac {2} {3} \times 9000000 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {1 \times 2 \times 2 \times 9000000} {2 \times 3 \times 3} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 3 \times 1000000} {2 \times 3 \times 3} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 3 \times 1000000} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
                                    &= 2 \times 1000000 \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 2000000
\end{aligned}
$

Share of Archie in Mr Rich wealth $= \pounds 2 \ \text{million}$.
</div>
</div>

**Question**

$193$ students receive a badge, and each badge costs $\pounds 6$.

How much does the school have to pay in total?

</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find the mass of Patrick who has a height of $1.5 \ \text{m}$ and a BMI of $20$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find the mass of Patrick who has a height of $1.5 \ \text{m}$ and a BMI of $20$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the mass of Patrick (in kg) $= m$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
20                                      &= \dfrac {m} {1.5 ^ 2} \\\\
20 \times 1.5 \times 1.5                &= m \\\\
m                                       &= \dfrac {20 \times 15 \times 15} {10 \times 10} \\\\
m                                       &= \dfrac {2 \times 10 \times 5 \times 3 \times 15} {2 \times 5 \times 10} \\\\
m                                       &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times \cancel {10} \times \cancel 5 \times 3 \times 15} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel {10}} \\\\
m                                       &= 3 \times 15 \\\\
m                                       &= 45 \ \text{kg} 
\end{aligned}
$

Mass of Patrick $= 45 \ \text{kg}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$45 \ \text{kg}$

</div>
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the mass of Patrick (in kg) $= m$

m                                       &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times \cancel {10} \times \cancel 5 \times 3 \times 15} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel {10}} \\\\
m                                       &= 3 \times 15 \\\\
m                                       &= 45 \ \text{kg} 
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

**Mobile phone calls**

My monthly mobile phone bill is in two parts: a fixed $\pounds 10$ service charge plus $5 \ \text{pence}$ for each call I make.

In October my bill was $\pounds 21.00$.

In November I made twice as many calls as in October.

Work out the cost of my November bill.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">**Mobile phone calls**
<emptyline>
My monthly mobile phone bill is in two parts: a fixed $\pounds 10$ service charge plus $5 \ \text{pence}$ for each call I make.
<emptyline>
In October my bill was $\pounds 21.00$.
<emptyline>
In November I made twice as many calls as in October.
<emptyline>
Work out the cost of my November bill.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Charge of phone calls}        &= \text{Total bill} - \text{Service charge} \\\\
                                    &= 21 - 10 \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 11
\end{aligned}
$

As per question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Phone calls charge in November}        &= 2 \times \text{Phone calls charge in October} \\\\
                                             &= 2 \times 11 \\\\
                                             &= \pounds 22 \\\\
\text{Total of November bill}                &= \text{Service charge} + \text{Phone calls charge} \\\\
                                             &= 10 + 22 \\\\
                                             &= \pounds 32
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 32$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Milly has some marbles at the start of the week.

One day at school she does well in her marble games with her friends and increase her total by a tenth.

The next day is not so good and she loses a tenth that time.

Has she ended up with more, less or the same as she had at the start of the week? Explain your answer carefully.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Milly has some marbles at the start of the week.
<emptyline>
One day at school she does well in her marble games with her friends and increase her total by a tenth.
<emptyline>
The next day is not so good and she loses a tenth that time.
<emptyline>
Has she ended up with more, less or the same as she had at the start of the week? Explain your answer carefully.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of marbles Milly had at the start of the week $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total marbles at the end of first day}     &= a + 10 \% \ \text{of} \ a \\\\
                                                 &= a + \dfrac {10} {100} \times a \\\\
                                                 &= a + \dfrac {10a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {a \times 100} {1 \times 100} + \dfrac {10a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {100a} {100} + \dfrac {10a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {100a + 10a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {110a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11 \cancel 0a} {10 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11a} {10} \\\\
\text{Total marbles at the end of second day}    &= \dfrac {11a} {10} - 10 \% \ \text{of} \ \dfrac {11a} {10} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11a} {10} - \dfrac {10} {100} \times \dfrac {11a} {10} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11a} {10} - \dfrac {10 \times 11a} {100 \times 10} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11a} {10} - \dfrac {\cancel {10} \times 11a} {100 \times \cancel {10}} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11a} {10} - \dfrac {11a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11a \times 10} {10 \times 10} - \dfrac {11a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {110a} {100} - \dfrac {11a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {110a - 11a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {99a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= 0.99a
\end{aligned}
$

She ended up with less marbles.
</div>
</div>

Less

**Question**

Emma has a rectangular  card $6 \ \text{cm}$ by $9 \ \text{cm}$. She colours in a border of $1 \ \text{cm}$ around  the edge. The border is $1 \ \text{cm}$ thick throughout. What fraction of the area of the rectangle is coloured in?

</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Cheese costs $\pounds 5.40 \ \text{per kg}$. Jessica buys $0.6\ \text{kg}$ of cheese. How much does Jessica pay? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Cheese costs $\pounds 5.40 \ \text{per kg}$. Jessica buys $0.6\ \text{kg}$ of cheese. How much does Jessica pay? 
</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Amount Jessica paid}      &= 5.40 \times 0.6 \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {54} {10} \times \dfrac {6} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {54 \times 6} {10 \times 10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {324} {100} \\\\
                                &= \pounds 3.24
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

There are $31 \ \text{days}$ in July. Each day throughout July I picked $300\ \text{g}$ of raspberries from my garden.

What was the total weight of the raspberries I picked that month? Give your answer in $\text{kilograms}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There are $31 \ \text{days}$ in July. Each day throughout July I picked $300\ \text{g}$ of raspberries from my garden.
<emptyline>
What was the total weight of the raspberries I picked that month? Give your answer in $\text{kilograms}$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total weight of the raspberries}          &= 31 \times \dfrac {300} {1000} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {31 \times 300} {1000} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {9300} {1000} \\\\
                                                &= 9.3 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9.3 \ \text{kg}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Natalie, Sara and Antonia catch $3$ different buses to go to the same destination.

Antonia catches the $19{:}15$ bus.

Natalie's bus journey takes three times as long as Sara's. 
Natalie's bus leaves $20 \ \text{minutes}$ before Antonia's bus and arrives at $20{:}10$. 
Sara catches the $19{:}25$ bus. 

What time does Sara arrive at the destination? 

![papers/james-allens-girls-school/2020/sample-paper-2/s01-q20-i00.png](/assets/papers/james-allens-girls-school/2020/sample-paper-2/s01-q20-i00.png "papers/james-allens-girls-school/2020/sample-paper-2/s01-q20-i00.png") 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Natalie, Sara and Antonia catch $3$ different buses to go to the same destination.
<emptyline>
Antonia catches the $19{:}15$ bus.
<emptyline>
Natalie's bus journey takes three times as long as Sara's. 
Natalie's bus leaves $20 \ \text{minutes}$ before Antonia's bus and arrives at $20{:}10$. 
Sara catches the $19{:}25$ bus. 
<emptyline>
What time does Sara arrive at the destination? 
<emptyline>
%image% 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time when Natalia catch the bus}           &= \text{Time when Antonia catch the bus} - 20 \ \text{min} \\\\
                                                 &= 19{:}15 - 20 \ \text{min} \\\\
                                                 &= 18{:}55 \\\\
\text{Duration of Natalia journey}               &= 20{:}10 - 18{:}55 \\\\
                                                 &= 75 \ \text{min} \\\\
\text{Duration of Sara journey}                  &= \dfrac {\text{Duration of Natalia journey}} {3} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {75} {3} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {3 \times 25} {3} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 25} {\cancel 3} \\\\
                                                 &= 25 \ \text{min} \\\\
\text{Time when Sara arrive at destination}      &= 19{:}25 + 25 \ \text{min} \\\\
                                                 &= 19{:}50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$19{:}50$

</div>
</div>

                                                 &= 19{:}15 - 20 \ \text{min} \\\\
                                                 &= 18{:}55 \\\\
\text{Duration of Natalia journey}               &= 20{:}10 - 18{:}55 \\\\

                                                 &= \dfrac {3 \times 25} {3} \\\\

                                                 &= 25 \ \text{min} \\\\

                                                 &= 19{:}50
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sara starts her maths homework at $4.30 \ \text{pm}$ and she finishes it at $6.10 \ \text{pm}$. 
During that time she watches 'Neighbours' for $25 \ \text{minutes}$ and 
she speaks to her friend Jean on the telephone for $20 \ \text{minutes}$. 
How long is Sara actually working on her maths?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sara starts her maths homework at $4.30 \ \text{pm}$ and she finishes it at $6.10 \ \text{pm}$. 
During that time she watches 'Neighbours' for $25 \ \text{minutes}$ and 
she speaks to her friend Jean on the telephone for $20 \ \text{minutes}$. 
How long is Sara actually working on her maths?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total time}                             &= 6:10 \ \text{pm} - 4:30 \ \text{pm} \\\\
                                              &= 100 \ \text{min} \\\\
\text{Time spent on homework}                 &= 100 - 25 - 20 \\\\
                                              &= 100 - 45 \\\\
                                              &= 55 \ \text{min}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$55 \ \text{min}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The total of the opposite faces on a dice is always $7$.
Jack places  three dice on a table as shown in the diagram. 
What is the total score of the faces that Jack cannot see?

![papers/james-allens-girls-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q19-i00.png](/assets/papers/james-allens-girls-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q19-i00.png "papers/james-allens-girls-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q19-i00.png")  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The total of the opposite faces on a dice is always $7$.
Jack places  three dice on a table as shown in the diagram. 
What is the total score of the faces that Jack cannot see?
<emptyline>
%image%  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total score of the faces that Jack cannot see}     &= 3 \times ((7 -6) + (7 - 3) + (7 - 2)) + 2 \times 2 \\\\
                                                         &= 3 \times (1 + 4 + 5) + 4 \\\\
                                                         &= 3 \times 10 + 4 \\\\
                                                         &= 30 + 4 \\\\
                                                         &= 34
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$34$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A length of rope is $5 \ \text{m}$ long. It is cut into four unequal lengths. Three of the pieces are $147 \ \text{cm}$, $132.5 \ \text{cm}$ and $67 \ \text{cm}$. How long is the fourth piece? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A length of rope is $5 \ \text{m}$ long. It is cut into four unequal lengths. Three of the pieces are $147 \ \text{cm}$, $132.5 \ \text{cm}$ and $67 \ \text{cm}$. How long is the fourth piece? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Length of fourth piece} &= 5 \ \text{m} - (147 \ \text{cm} + 132.5 \ \text{cm} + 67 \ \text{cm}) \\\\
                               &= 5 \ \text{m} - 346.5 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                               &= 5 \ \text{m} - \dfrac {346.5} {100} \ \text{m} \\\\
                               &= 5 - 3.465 \\\\
                               &= 1.535 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1.535 \ \text{m}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Length of fourth piece} &= 5 \ \text{m} - (147 \ \text{cm} + 132.5 \ \text{cm} + 67 \ \text{cm}) \\\\
                               &= 5 \ \text{m} - 346.5 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                               &= 5 \ \text{m} - \dfrac {346.5} {100} \ \text{m} \\\\

\end{aligned}

</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tom is $142 \ \text{cm}$ tall and Harry is $168 \ \text{cm}$ tall. 
James is half way between Tom's and Harry's height. 
Work out James' height. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Tom is $142 \ \text{cm}$ tall and Harry is $168 \ \text{cm}$ tall. 
James is half way between Tom's and Harry's height. 
Work out James' height. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {James' height} &= \dfrac {\text {Tom's height} + \text {Harry's height}} {2} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {142 + 168} {2} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {310} {2} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {155 \times 2} {2} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {155 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
                      &= 155 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$155 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$3$ masses are measured to be $720 \ \text{g}$, $3.46 \ \text{kg}$, and $2 \ \text{kg } 53 \ \text{g}$. 
What is their total mass, give your answer in grams. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$3$ masses are measured to be $720 \ \text{g}$, $3.46 \ \text{kg}$, and $2 \ \text{kg } 53 \ \text{g}$. 
What is their total mass, give your answer in grams. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
