<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total mass} &= 720 \ \text{g} + 3.46 \ \text{kg} + 2 \ \text{kg} \ 53 \ \text{g} \\\\
                   &= 720 \ \text{g} + 3.46 \times 1000 \ \text{g} + 2 \times 1000 \ \text{g} + 53 \ \text{g} \\\\
                   &= 720 + 3.46 \times 1000 + 2 \times 1000 + 53 \\\\
                   &= 720 + 3460 + 2000 + 53 \\\\
                   &= 6233 \ \text{g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$6233 \ \text{g}$

</div>

**Question**

Nine people sit at one table. They share the chocolate equally.

![papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s01-i00.png](/assets/papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s01-i00.png "papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s01-i00.png")

What fraction of a bar do they each have?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

$

                             &= \dfrac {\cancel {3}} {3 \times \cancel {3}} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {1} {3}
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

In another room there are two tables.

There are four bars of chocolate on one table. There are five on the other.

![papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s03-i00.png](/assets/papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s03-i00.png "papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s03-i00.png") ![papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s03-i01.png](/assets/papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s03-i01.png "papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s03-i01.png")

Twelve people sit at the table with four bars. Some other people sit at the table with five bars.

At each table they share the chocolate equally. Everyone in the room has the same fraction of a bar.

How many people sit at the table with five bars?

Show your working.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In another room there are two tables.
<emptyline>
There are four bars of chocolate on one table. There are five on the other.
<emptyline>
%image% %image%
<emptyline>
Twelve people sit at the table with four bars. Some other people sit at the table with five bars.
<emptyline>
At each table they share the chocolate equally. Everyone in the room has the same fraction of a bar.
<emptyline>
How many people sit at the table with five bars?
<emptyline>
Show your working.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of people sitting at the table with five bars $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {4} {12}                                                         &= \dfrac {5} {a} \\\\
4a                                                                      &= 5 \times 12 \\\\
a                                                                       &= \dfrac {5 \times 12} {4} \\\\
a                                                                       &= \dfrac {5 \times 3 \times 4} {4} \\\\
a                                                                       &= \dfrac {5 \times 3 \times \cancel {4}} {\cancel {4}} \\\\
a                                                                       &= 5 \times 3 \\\\
a                                                                       &= 15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$15$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A number line starts at $-9$ and finishes at $11$.

What number is $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the way along the number line?

![papers/kent-college-canterbury/2020/sample-paper-1/s01-q13-i00.png](/assets/papers/kent-college-canterbury/2020/sample-paper-1/s01-q13-i00.png "papers/kent-college-canterbury/2020/sample-paper-1/s01-q13-i00.png")

Show your working. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A number line starts at $-9$ and finishes at $11$.
<emptyline>
What number is $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the way along the number line?
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
Show your working. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Effective length of the number line} &= 11 - (-9) \\\\
                                           &= 11 + 9 \\\\
                                           &= 20
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Position of required number from start}    &= \dfrac {2} {5} \times 20 \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times 20} {5} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 4} {5} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel {5} \times 4} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
                                                 &= 2 \times 4 \\\\
                                                 &= 8
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number}        &= - 9 + 8 \\\\
                     &= - 1
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$- 1$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Bill has a bag containing $60$ sweets. He eats a half of the sweets himself and then gives away a third of the sweets that remain. How many sweets does Bill have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Bill has a bag containing $60$ sweets. He eats a half of the sweets himself and then gives away a third of the sweets that remain. How many sweets does Bill have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Sweets left}  &= \text {Total sweets} - (\text {Sweets eaten} + \text {Sweets given away}) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text {of} \ 60 + \dfrac {1} {3} \ \text {of} \ \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text {of} \ 60 \bigg) \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 +\dfrac {1} {3} \times \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 \bigg) \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {60} {2} + \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {60} {2} \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {30 \times 2} {2} + \dfrac {10 \times 3 \times 2} {3 \times 2} \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {30 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 2} + \dfrac {10 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 3 \times \cancel 2} \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - (30 + 10) \\\\
                     &= 60 - 40 \\\\
                     &= 20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20$

</div>
</div>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Sweets left}  &= \text {Total sweets} - (\text {Sweets eaten} + \text {Sweets given away}) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text {of} \ 60 + \dfrac {1} {3} \ \text {of} \ \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text {of} \ 60 \bigg) \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 +\dfrac {1} {3} \times \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 \bigg) \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {60} {2} + \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {60} {2} \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {30 \times 2} {2} + \dfrac {10 \times 3 \times 2} {3 \times 2} \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {30 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 2} + \dfrac {10 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 3 \times \cancel 2} \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - (30 + 10) \\\\
                     &= 60 - 40 \\\\
                     &= 20
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Duration of film shot inside The Manor House} &= (100 - 3 \% \ \text{of} \ 100 - 25 - \dfrac {1} {5} \ \text{of} \ 100 - 0.17 \ \text{of} \ 100) \\\\
                                                    &= 100 - \dfrac {3} {100} \times 100 - 25 - \dfrac {1} {5} \times 100 - \dfrac {17} {100} \times 100 \\\\
                                                    &= 100 - 25 - \dfrac {3 \times 100} {100} - \dfrac {100} {5} - \dfrac {17 \times 100} {100} \\\\
                                                    &= 75 - \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {100}} {\cancel {100}} - \dfrac {5 \times 20} {5} - \dfrac {17 \times \cancel {100}} {\cancel {100}} \\\\
                                                    &= 75 - 3 - 17 - \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 20} {\cancel 5} \\\\
                                                    &= 75 - 20 - 20 \\\\
                                                    &= 35 \ \text{min}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of film shot inside The Manor House} &= \dfrac {35} {100} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {7 \times 5} {20 \times 5} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel 5} {20 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {7} {20}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

\begin{aligned}
\text {Purple Smarties}  &= \text {Total Smarties} - (\text{Red Smarties} + \text{Green Smarties}) \\\\
                         &= 92 - (37 + 29) \\\\
                         &= 92 - 66 \\\\
                         &= 26
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jenny is given $3$ large jigsaw puzzles for Christmas which get muddled together. The first contains $496$ pieces, the second $812$ pieces and the third $984$ pieces.

By rounding each of these numbers to the nearest $100$, write down a simple sum you can do to estimate the total number of jigsaw pieces there are all together.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

By rounding each of these numbers to the nearest $100$, write down a simple sum you can do to estimate the total number of jigsaw pieces there are all together.
</code></pre>
</div>

                                                &= 2300

$

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Meera is now exactly $3$ times as tall as she was when she was born. What was her height in centimetres when she was born?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Meera is now exactly $3$ times as tall as she was when she was born. What was her height in centimetres when she was born?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Meera's height when she was born}   &= \dfrac {1.62} {3} \ \text{m} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {1.62 \times 100} {3} \ \text{cm} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {162} {3} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {54 \times 3} {3} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {54 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3}} \\\\
                                          &= 54 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}
$

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A school requires enough pencils so that each of its $340$ pupils can have a pencil each. How many boxes of $24$ pencils should the school buy, and how many spare pencils will this leave?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A school requires enough pencils so that each of its $340$ pupils can have a pencil each. How many boxes of $24$ pencils should the school buy, and how many spare pencils will this leave?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of boxes required}         &= \dfrac {340} {24} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {85 \times 4} {6 \times 4} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {85 \times \cancel 4} {6 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {85} {6} \\\\
                                        &= 14 \text{ remainder } 1 \\\\
                                        &\approx 15 \\\\
\text{Number of spare pencils}          &= 15 \times 24 - 340\\\\
                                        &= 360 - 340 \\\\
                                        &= 20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Number of boxes $= 15$

Number of spare pencils $= 20$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of boxes required}         &= \dfrac {340} {24} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {85 \times 4} {6 \times 4} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {85 \times \cancel 4} {6 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {85} {6} \\\\
                                        &= 14 \text{ remainder } 1 \\\\
                                        &\approx 15 \\\\
\text{Number of spare pencils}          &= 15 \times 24 - 340\\\\
                                        &= 360 - 340 \\\\
                                        &= 20
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A ball of string is $2\ \text{metres}$ long. Pieces of length $30\ \text{cm}$ are cut from the ball. How many whole pieces may be cut and what length is left over?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A ball of string is $2\ \text{metres}$ long. Pieces of length $30\ \text{cm}$ are cut from the ball. How many whole pieces may be cut and what length is left over?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of pieces} &= \dfrac {\text{Length of string}} {\text{Length of a piece}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \ \text{m}} {30  \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \times 100 \ \text{cm}} {30 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \times 10 \cancel {0}} {3 \cancel {0}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {20} {3} \\\\
                        &= 6 \text{ remainder } 2 \\\\
                        &\approx 6 \\\\
\text{Remaining length}     &= 2 \ \text{m} - 6 \times 30 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                            &= 2 \times 100 \ \text{cm} - 6 \times 30 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                            &= 200 - 180 \\\\
                            &= 20 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6, 20 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$

\text{Number of pieces} &= \dfrac {\text{Length of string}} {\text{Length of a piece}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \ \text{m}} {30  \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \times 100 \ \text{cm}} {30 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \times 10 \cancel {0}} {3 \cancel {0}} \\\\

\text{Remaining length}     &= 2 \ \text{m} - 6 \times 30 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                            &= 2 \times 100 \ \text{cm} - 6 \times 30 \ \text{cm} \\\\

$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A glass holds $225\ \text{ml}$.

![papers/leicester-high-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-4/s01-q06-s01-i00.png](/assets/papers/leicester-high-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-4/s01-q06-s01-i00.png "papers/leicester-high-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-4/s01-q06-s01-i00.png")

An adult needs about $1.8\ \text{litres}$ of water each day to stay healthy.

How many glasses is that? 

Show your working.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A glass holds $225\ \text{ml}$.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
An adult needs about $1.8\ \text{litres}$ of water each day to stay healthy.
<emptyline>
How many glasses is that? 
<emptyline>
Show your working.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Amount of water needed per day}     &= 1.8 \ \text{litres} \\\\
                                          &= 1.8 \times 1000 \ \text{ml} \\\\
                                          &= 1.8 \times 1000 \\\\
                                          &= 1800 \ \text{ml} \\\\
\text{Number of glasses of water}         &= \dfrac {1800} {225} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {8 \times 225} {225} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {8 \times \cancel {225}} {\cancel {225}} \\\\
                                          &= 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of chocolates each student receives} &= \dfrac {\text {Total chocolates}} {\text {Total students}} \\\\
                                                   &= \dfrac {36 \times 4} {27} \\\\
                                                   &= \dfrac {9 \times 4 \times 4} {9 \times 3} \\\\

                                                   &= \dfrac {16} {3} \\\\
                                                   &= 5 \text{ remainder } 1 \\\\
                                                   &\approx 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 ^ a \times 100 &> 100000 \\\\
2 ^ a            &> \dfrac {100000} {100} \\\\
2 ^ a            &> \dfrac {1000 \cancel{00}} {1 \cancel{00}} \\\\
2 ^ a            &> 1000
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the value by using trial and error. Lets find out the value of $a$ that satisfies the above equation.

| a    |   Value of $2 ^ a$ |  Value $> 5000$    |
|:----:|:----------------:  |:------------------:|
| $9$  |       $512$        |    $\text {No}$    |
| $10$ |       $1024$       |    $\text {Yes}$   |

Number of weeks $= 10$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A bag contains $49$ red balls and $1$ blue ball. How many red balls should be removed for the bag to contain $90\%$ red balls?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A bag contains $49$ red balls and $1$ blue ball. How many red balls should be removed for the bag to contain $90\%$ red balls?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of red balls removed $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {49 - b} {50 - b}                                             &= \dfrac {90} {100} \\\\
49 - b                                                               &= \dfrac {90} {100} \times (50 - b) \\\\
49 - b                                                               &= \dfrac {90} {100} \times 50 - \dfrac {90} {100} \times b \\\\
49 - b                                                               &= \dfrac {45 \times 2 \times 50} {50 \times 2} - \dfrac {90 b} {100} \\\\
49 - b                                                               &= \dfrac {45 \times \cancel {2} \times \cancel {50}} {\cancel {50} \times \cancel {2}} - \dfrac {90 b} {100} \\\\
49 - b                                                               &= 45 - \dfrac {90 b} {100} \\\\
-b + \dfrac {90 b} {100}                                             &= 45 - 49 \\\\
-\dfrac {b \times 100} {1 \times 100} + \dfrac {90 b} {100}          &= -4 \\\\
-\dfrac {100 b + 90 b} {100}                                         &= -4 \\\\
-\dfrac {10 b} {100}                                                 &= -4 \\\\
\dfrac {10 b} {100}                                                  &= 4 \\\\
\dfrac {1 \cancel {0} b} {10 \cancel {0}}                            &= 4 \\\\
\dfrac {b} {10}                                                      &= 4 \\\\
b                                                                    &= 4 \times 10 \\\\
b                                                                    &= 40
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Alternate solution
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total number of balls after red balls removed $= a$

Number of blue balls,

$
\begin{aligned}
10 \% \ \text{of} \ a            &= 1 \\\\
\dfrac {10} {100} \times a   &= 1 \\\\
a                            &= \dfrac {100} {10} \\\\
a                            &= \dfrac {10 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0} \\\\
a                            &= 10
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Red balls}           &= \text{Total balls} - \text {Blue balls} \\\\
                           &= 10 - 1 \\\\
                           &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Red balls removed}   &= 49 - 9 \\\\
                           &= 40
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If a basketball weighs $300 \ \text{g}$ plus half its own weight, how much does it weigh?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If a basketball weighs $300 \ \text{g}$ plus half its own weight, how much does it weigh?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of basketball $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
b                                                 &= 300 + \dfrac {b} {2} \\\\
b - \dfrac {b} {2}                                &= 300 \\\\
\dfrac {b \times 2} {1 \times 2} - \dfrac {b} {2} &= 300 \\\\
\dfrac {2 b} {2} - \dfrac {b} {2}                 &= 300 \\\\
\dfrac {2 b - b} {2}                              &= 300 \\\\
\dfrac {b} {2}                                    &= 300 \\\\
b                                                 &= 300 \times 2 \\\\
b                                                 &= 600 \ \text{g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$600 \ \text{g}$

</div>

**Question**

An egg box holds $6$ eggs. How many boxes are needed for $100$ eggs?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">An egg box holds $6$ eggs. How many boxes are needed for $100$ eggs?
</code></pre>

                                    &= \dfrac {50 \times 2} {2 \times 3} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {50 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2} \times 3} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {50} {3} \\\\
                                    &= 16 \text{ remainder } 2 \\\\
                                    &\approx 17
\end{aligned}
$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 3 \times 60} {\cancel 2} \\\\
                                            &= 3 \times 60 \\\\
                                            &= 180 \ \text{metres}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A metal rod is $10 \dfrac{4}{5} \ \text{metres}$ long.  How many short rods $\dfrac{3}{10} \ \text{metres}$ 
long can be cut from the longer rod?  

Show full working

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A metal rod is $10 \dfrac{4}{5} \ \text{metres}$ long.  How many short rods $\dfrac{3}{10} \ \text{metres}$ 
long can be cut from the longer rod?  
<emptyline>
Show full working
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Numbers of rods} &= \dfrac {\text {Length of longer rod}} {\text {Length of shorter rod}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {10 \dfrac {4} {5}} {\dfrac {3} {10}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\dfrac {54} {5}} {\dfrac {3} {10}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {54} {5} \times \dfrac {10} {3} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {54 \times 10} {5 \times 3} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 18 \times 5 \times 2} {5 \times 3} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 18 \times \cancel {5} \times 2} {\cancel {5} \times \cancel {3}} \\\\
                        &= 18 \times 2 \\\\
                        &= 36
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$36$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

There are $120$ boys and $80$ girls at a small primary school. During the holidays, $50\%$ of the boys and $60\%$ of the girls saw the latest Harry Potter movie. How many pupils in total from the primary school saw the movie?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There are $120$ boys and $80$ girls at a small primary school. During the holidays, $50\%$ of the boys and $60\%$ of the girls saw the latest Harry Potter movie. How many pupils in total from the primary school saw the movie?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total pupils who saw the movie}   &= \dfrac {50} {100} \times {120} + \dfrac {60} {100} \times {80} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {50 \times 120} {100} + \dfrac {60 \times 80} {100} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {5 \cancel 0 \times 12 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} + \dfrac {6 \cancel 0 \times 8 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                         &= 5 \times 12 + 6 \times 8 \\\\
                                         &= 60 + 48 \\\\
                                         &= 128
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$128$

</div>
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

John and Daisy share a pizza. John eats $\dfrac{1}{5}$ of it and Daisy eats $\dfrac{7}{12}$ of it. What fraction remains?                                          

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">John and Daisy share a pizza. John eats $\dfrac{1}{5}$ of it and Daisy eats $\dfrac{7}{12}$ of it. What fraction remains?                                          
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of pizza remaining}      &= 1 - (\dfrac {1}{5} + \dfrac{7}{12} ) \\\\
                                        &= 1 - (\dfrac {1 \times 12} {5 \times 12} + \dfrac{7 \times 5}{12 \times 5}) \\\\
                                        &= 1 - (\dfrac {12}{60} + \dfrac {35}{60}) \\\\
                                        &= 1 - \dfrac {47} {60} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {60 - 47} {60} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {13} {60}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {13} {60}$

<div class="question subsubquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If there are $14$ small bottles, how many large bottles will be needed?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If there are $14$ small bottles, how many large bottles will be needed?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of large bottles needed $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
14 \times 1 \dfrac {1} {4}      &= a \times 3 \dfrac {4} {7} \\\\
14 \times \dfrac {5} {4}        &= a \times \dfrac {25} {7} \\\\
a \times \dfrac {25} {7}        &= 14 \times \dfrac {5} {4} \\\\
a                               &= 14 \times \dfrac {5} {4} \times \dfrac {7} {25} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {14 \times 5 \times 7} {4 \times 25} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {7 \times 2 \times 5 \times 7} {2 \times 2 \times 5 \times 5} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times 7} {\cancel 2 \times 2 \times 5 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {7 \times 7} {2 \times 5} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {49} {10} \\\\
a                               &= 4 \text{ remainder } 9 \\\\
a                               &\approx 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

&= - \dfrac {1} {35}
\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A chocolate bar is shared amongst two friends. 

Alfred first eats one third of the bar. Barbara then eats two thirds of the remaining chocolate.

What fraction of the original chocolate bar is left? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A chocolate bar is shared amongst two friends. 
<emptyline>
Alfred first eats one third of the bar. Barbara then eats two thirds of the remaining chocolate.
<emptyline>
What fraction of the original chocolate bar is left? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction eaten by Alferd}    &= \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
                                   &= 1 - \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {1 \times 3} {1 \times 3} - \dfrac {1}{3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {3} {3} - \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {3 - 1} {3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {2} {3} \\\\
\text{Fraction eaten by Barbara}   &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times \dfrac{2} {3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {2 \times 2} {3 \times 3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {4} {9} \\\\
                                   &= 1 - \dfrac {4}{9} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {1 \times 9} {1 \times 9} - \dfrac {4}{9} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {9-4} {9} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {5} {9}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {5} {9}$

</div>
</div>

</div>

                                   &= 1 - \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {1 \times 3} {1 \times 3} - \dfrac {1}{3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {3} {3} - \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {3 - 1} {3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {2} {3} \\\\
\text{Fraction eaten by Barbara}   &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times \dfrac{2} {3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {2 \times 2} {3 \times 3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {4} {9} \\\\
                                   &= 1 - \dfrac {4}{9} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {1 \times 9} {1 \times 9} - \dfrac {4}{9} \\\\

                                   &= \dfrac {5} {9}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In the first week of the screening of a new film a cinema sells $2140$ tickets. 

In the second week it sells $320$ less tickets than the first week.

In the third week it sells $210$ less tickets than the second week.

How many tickets are sold over the three weeks?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the first week of the screening of a new film a cinema sells $2140$ tickets. 
<emptyline>
In the second week it sells $320$ less tickets than the first week.
<emptyline>
In the third week it sells $210$ less tickets than the second week.
<emptyline>
How many tickets are sold over the three weeks?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total ticket sold }    &= 2140 + (2140 - 320) + (2140 - 320 - 210) \\\\                                                                 
                             &= 2140 + 1820 + 1610 \\\\
                             &= 3960 + 1610 \\\\
                             &= 5570
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5570$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

![papers/reigate-grammar-school/2012/sample-paper-3/s01-q21-i00.png](/assets/papers/reigate-grammar-school/2012/sample-paper-3/s01-q21-i00.png "papers/reigate-grammar-school/2012/sample-paper-3/s01-q21-i00.png")

What fraction of this flag is shaded? How many more rectangles need to be shaded to fill $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of the flag?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%image%
<emptyline>
What fraction of this flag is shaded? How many more rectangles need to be shaded to fill $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of the flag?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of flag shaded}              &= \dfrac {5} {6 \times 5} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel{5}} {6 \times \cancel{5}} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
\text{Rectangles required}                  &= \left( \dfrac {2} {3} \times 30 \right) - 5 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {2 \times 30} {3} - 5 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {60} {3} - 5 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {20 \times 3} {3} - 5 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {20 \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{3}} - 5 \\\\
                                            &= 20 - 5 \\\\
                                            &= 15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {6}, 15$

</div>
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A transport company's vans each carry a maximum load of $12 \ \text{tonnes}$. A firm needs to deliver $24$ crates each weighing $5\ \text{tonnes}$. How many vans are needed?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A transport company's vans each carry a maximum load of $12 \ \text{tonnes}$. A firm needs to deliver $24$ crates each weighing $5\ \text{tonnes}$. How many vans are needed?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total vans needed}                &= \dfrac {\text{Total crates} \times \text{Weight of 1 crate}} {\text{Maximum load van can take}} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {24 \times 5} {12} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {2 \times 12 \times 5} {12} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel{12} \times 5} {\cancel{12}} \\\\
                                        &= 2 \times 5 \\\\
                                        &= 10
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$10$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A train carriage has $62$ seats, if the train has $12$ carriages what is the largest number of passengers it can seat?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A train carriage has $62$ seats, if the train has $12$ carriages what is the largest number of passengers it can seat?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Largest number of passengers}    &= 62 \times 12 \\\\
                                        &= 744
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$744$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many spots are there on a normal six-sided dice?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many spots are there on a normal six-sided dice?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Numbers of spots on six different sides of dice}  &= 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 \\\\
\text{Total spots}                                      &= 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 \\\\
                                                        &= 21
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As we know, opposite sides of a dice always add up to 7.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total spots}                                 &= \dfrac {6} {2} \times 7 \\\\
                                                   &= 3 \times 7 \\\\
                                                   &= 21
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$21$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

She can lay $6$ bricks every $4 \ \text{minutes}$. How long will it take her to build the wall?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">She can lay $6$ bricks every $4 \ \text{minutes}$. How long will it take her to build the wall?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time to build the wall}                       &= \dfrac {4} {6} \times 276 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {4 \times 276} {6} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {4 \times 6 \times 46} {6} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {4 \times \cancel{6} \times 46} {\cancel{6}} \\\\
                                                    &= 4 \times 46 \\\\
                                                    &= 184 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                                    &= 3 \ \text{hours} \ 4 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3 \text{ hours } 4 \text{ minutes}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

He can lay $7$ bricks every $5 \ \text{minutes}$. How long will it take him to build the wall? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">He can lay $7$ bricks every $5 \ \text{minutes}$. How long will it take him to build the wall? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time}         &= \dfrac {\text{Total bricks}} {7} \times 5  \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {266} {7} \times 5 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {7 \times 38 \times 5} {7} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {\cancel{7} \times 38 \times 5} {\cancel{7}} \\\\
                    &= 38 \times 5 \\\\
                    &= 190 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{190}{60} \ \text{hours} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{19 \times 2 \times 5}{2 \times 5 \times 6} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{19 \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{5}}{\cancel{2} \times \cancel{5} \times 6} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {19} {6} \\\\
                    &= 3 \ \text{hours} \ 10 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3 \ \text{hours} \ 10 \ \text{minutes or } 190 \ \text{minutes}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">- rtq_abbr_note_md_unit
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

</div>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time}         &= \dfrac {\text{Total bricks}} {7} \times 5  \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {266} {7} \times 5 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {7 \times 38 \times 5} {7} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {\cancel{7} \times 38 \times 5} {\cancel{7}} \\\\
                    &= 38 \times 5 \\\\
                    &= 190 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{190}{60} \ \text{hours} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{19 \times 2 \times 5}{2 \times 5 \times 6} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{19 \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{5}}{\cancel{2} \times \cancel{5} \times 6} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {19} {6} \\\\
                    &= 3 \ \text{hours} \ 10 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many pieces of ribbon of $30\ \text{cm}$ length can be cut from a piece of length $7\ \text{m}?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many pieces of ribbon of $30\ \text{cm}$ length can be cut from a piece of length $7\ \text{m}?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total ribbons}    &= \dfrac {7 \times 1 \ \text{m}} {30 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {7 \times 100 \ \text{cm}} {30 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {70 \times 2 \times 5} {3 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {70 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {3 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {70} {3} \\\\
                        &= 23 \text{ remainder } 1 \\\\
                        &\approx 23
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$23$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mrs Walker is planning a party for her grand-daughter and there will be $70$ children in total.

Each child will have a party bag to take home with a lollipop 
and a toy.

Empty party bags are sold in packs of $12$ and cost $\pounds2$ per pack.

Lollipops are sold in packs of $8$ and cost $\pounds4$ per pack.

Toys are sold in packs of $9$ and cost $\pounds10$ per pack.

As a special new year offer, all prices are reduced by one quarter.

How many packs of each item will she need to buy and what will be her total cost? Show all your working clearly. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mrs Walker is planning a party for her grand-daughter and there will be $70$ children in total.
<emptyline>
Each child will have a party bag to take home with a lollipop 
and a toy.
<emptyline>
Empty party bags are sold in packs of $12$ and cost $\pounds2$ per pack.
<emptyline>
Lollipops are sold in packs of $8$ and cost $\pounds4$ per pack.
<emptyline>
Toys are sold in packs of $9$ and cost $\pounds10$ per pack.
<emptyline>
As a special new year offer, all prices are reduced by one quarter.
<emptyline>
How many packs of each item will she need to buy and what will be her total cost? Show all your working clearly. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{New cost of solid bag}                     &= 2 - 2 \times \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 2 -  \dfrac{1 \times 2}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 2 -  \dfrac{1 \times \cancel{2}}{2 \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
                                                 &= 2 -  \dfrac{1}{2} \\\\
                                                 &= 2 -  0.5 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 1.5 \\\\
\text{New cost of lollipops}                     &= 4 - 4 \times \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 4 - 4 \times \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 4 - \dfrac{4}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 4 - \dfrac{\cancel{4}}{\cancel{4}} \\\\
                                                 &= 4 - 1 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 3 \\\\
\text{New cost of toys}                          &= 10 - 10 \times \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 10 - \dfrac{10}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 10 - \dfrac{5 \times 2}{2 \times 2} \\\\
                                                 &= 10 - \dfrac{5 \times \cancel{2}}{2 \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
                                                 &= 10 - \dfrac{5}{2} \\\\
                                                 &= 10 - 2.5 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 7.5 \\\\
\text{Number of party bags required}             &= 70 \div 12 \\\\
												 &= \dfrac {70} {12}
                                                 &= 5 \text{ remainder } 10 \\\\
                                                 &\approx 6 \\\\
\text{Cost of party bags for }70\text{ children} &= 6 \times 1.5 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 9 \\\\
\text{Number of lollipop packs required}         &= 70 \div 8 \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {70} {8} \\\\
                                                 &= 8 \text{ remainder } 6 \\\\
                                                 &\approx 9\\\\
\text{Cost of lollipops for }70\text{ children}  &= 9 \times 3 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 27 \\\\
\text{Number of toy packs required}              &= 70 \div 9 \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {70} {9} \\\\
                                                 &= 7 \text{ remainder } 7 \\\\
                                                 &\approx 8 \\\\
\text{Cost of toys for }70\text{ children}       &= 8 \times 7.5 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 60 \\\\
\text{Total cost}                                &= 60 + 27 + 9 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 95
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 95$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A sunflower is one hundred and fifty centimetres tall.

How tall will it be if its height increases by ten per cent?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A sunflower is one hundred and fifty centimetres tall.
<emptyline>
How tall will it be if its height increases by ten per cent?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If the height is increased by $10\%$ then new height will be $100 + 10 = 110\%$ of the orginal height.

Using this we get,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{New height}  &= 110 \% \text { of} \ 150 \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {110} {100} \times 150 \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {110 \times 150} {100} \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {11 \cancel {0} \times 15 \cancel {0}} {1 \cancel {0} \cancel {0}} \\\\
                   &= 11 \times 15 \\\\
                   &= 165 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$165 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

One display cabinet holds $38$ DVDs. How many cabinets will be needed to hold $646$ DVDs? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>

</code></pre>

                                        &= \dfrac {17 \times 38} {38} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {17 \times \cancel {38}} {\cancel{38}} \\\\
                                        &= 17
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Lizzie gets $20\%$ on a $10$-problem test, $80\%$ on a $20$-problem test and $9 \%$ on a $30$-problem test. If the three tests are combined into one $60$-problem test, what percentage is her overall score?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Lizzie gets $20\%$ on a $10$-problem test, $80\%$ on a $20$-problem test and $9 \%$ on a $30$-problem test. If the three tests are combined into one $60$-problem test, what percentage is her overall score?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}\
\text{Marks Lizzie got in 10-problem set}   &= 20 \% \ \text{of} \ 10 \\\\ 
                                            &= \dfrac{20}{100} \times 10 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{20 \times 10}{100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{2 \cancel 0 \times 1 \cancel 0}{1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 2 \\\\
\text{Marks Lizzie got in 20-problem set}   &= 80 \% \ \text{of} \ 20 \\\\ 
                                            &= \dfrac{80}{100} \times 20 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{80 \times 20}{100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{8 \cancel 0 \times 2 \cancel 0}{1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 8 \times 2 \\\\
                                            &= 16 \\\\
\text{Marks Lizzie got in 30-problem set}   &= 90 \% \ \text{of} \ 30 \\\\ 
                                            &= \dfrac{90}{100} \times 30 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{90 \times 30}{100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{9 \cancel 0 \times 3 \cancel 0}{1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 9 \times 3 \\\\
                                            &= 27 \\\\
\text{Total precentage}                     &= \dfrac{2 + 16 + 27}{60} \times 100 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{45}{60} \times 100 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{45 \times 100}{60} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{15 \times 3 \times 4 \times 25}{15 \times 4} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{\cancel {15} \times 3 \times \cancel 4 \times 25}{\cancel {15} \times \cancel 4} \\\\
                                            &= 3 \times 25 \\\\
                                            &= 75 \ \%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$75 \ \%$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A number is called a palindrome if it reads the same backwards as forwards. For example, $13931$ is a palindrome. 

What is the difference between the least $5$-digit palindrome number and the greatest $6$-digit palindrome number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A number is called a palindrome if it reads the same backwards as forwards. For example, $13931$ is a palindrome.

</code></pre>

\text{6 digit largest palindromic number}       &= 999999 \\\\

                                                &= 989998
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

I got $30\%$ on a $10$-problem test, $70\%$ on a $20$-problem test and $80\%$ on a $30$-problem test.

If the three tests are combined into one $60$-problem test, what percentage is my overall score?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I got $30\%$ on a $10$-problem test, $70\%$ on a $20$-problem test and $80\%$ on a $30$-problem test.
<emptyline>
If the three tests are combined into one $60$-problem test, what percentage is my overall score?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Overall score}            &= \dfrac {10} {100} \times 10 + \dfrac {70} {100} \times 20 + \dfrac {80} {100} \times 30 \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {10 \times 10} {100} + \dfrac {70 \times 20} {100} + \dfrac {80 \times 30} {100} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {100} {100} + \dfrac {14 \times 5 \times 20} {20 \times 5} + \dfrac {20 \times 4 \times 6 \times 5} {20 \times 5} \\\\
                                 &= 1 + 14 + 6 \times 4 \\\\
                                 &= 15 + 24 \\\\ 
                                 &= 39 \\\\
\text {Overall percentage}       &= \dfrac {39} {60} \times 100 \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {3 \times 13 \times 2 \times 5 \times 10} {2 \times 3 \times 10} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 13 \times \cancel {2} \times 5 \times \cancel {10}} {\cancel {2} \times \cancel {3} \times \cancel {10}} \\\\
                                 &= 13 \times 5 \\\\
                                 &= 65 \%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$65 \%$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Take a $2$ digit number, then reverse it. Take the smaller number away from the larger.

[For example, starting with $83$, you would form $83 - 38 = 45$. Starting with $91$, you would form $91 - 19 = 72$]

Do this several times. What do you notice about your answers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ben's Dad was making a fence for their garden. He needed to buy a piece of wood that he could cut into $14$ equal parts. If each part had to be $114 \ \text{cm}$ long, what length would the piece of wood need to be?

</div>

**Question**

In a class of $40$ pupils, $14$ failed the physical fitness test. What percentage of the class failed the test?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>

</code></pre>

\text{Percentage of class failed the test}       &= \dfrac{14}{40} \times 100 \\\\ 
                                                 &= \dfrac{14 \times 100}{40} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac{7 \times 2 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5}{2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\

                                                 &= 7 \times 5 \\\\
                                                 &= 35\%
\end{aligned}
$
