**Question**

The family keep eight of the filled boxes to give to friends. The rest are sold in the farm shop.

What percentage of the filled boxes are sold in the farm shop?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The family keep eight of the filled boxes to give to friends. The rest are sold in the farm shop.
<emptyline>
What percentage of the filled boxes are sold in the farm shop?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
\text {Percentage of filled boxes sold in the farm shop}     &= \dfrac {32 - 8} {32} \times 100 \\\\
                                                             &= \dfrac {24} {32} \times 100 \\\\
                                                             &= \dfrac {24 \times 100} {32} \\\\
                                                             &= \dfrac {3 \times 8 \times 4 \times 25} {8 \times 4} \\\\
                                                             &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {8} \times \cancel {4} \times 25} {\cancel {8} \times \cancel {4}} \\\\
                                                             &= 3 \times 25 \\\\
                                                             &= 75\%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A shop has an end-of-season sale. Everything is reduced by $15\%$. A dress is originally priced at $\pounds 48$ (full price). What is the sale price of the dress?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A shop has an end-of-season sale. Everything is reduced by $15\%$. A dress is originally priced at $\pounds 48$ (full price). What is the sale price of the dress?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sale price}  &= 85\% \ \text{of} \ \pounds 48 \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {85 \times 48} { 100 } \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {5 \times 17 \times 2 \times 24} {2 \times 5 \times 10} \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 17 \times \cancel{2} \times 24} {\cancel{2} \times \cancel{5} \times 10 } \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {17 \times 24} {10} \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {408} {10} \\\\
                   &= \pounds 40.8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 40.8$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If the concert hall is $75\%$ full, how many seats are empty? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If the concert hall is $75\%$ full, how many seats are empty? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If the concert hall is 75% full, then the hall is: 100% - 75% = 25% empty.

Using that we get,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Empty seats}  &= 25 \% \ \text {of} \ 4480 \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {25} {100} \times 4480 \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {5 \times 5 \times 2 \times 2 \times 1120} {5 \times 5 \times 2 \times 2} \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times 1120} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
                     &= 1120
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1120$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Nicola has four number cards:

$\Large{\boxed{1} \quad \boxed{2} \quad \boxed{8} \quad \boxed{9}}$
 
She arranges them to form two $2$ digit numbers. She multiplies the numbers together. Calculate the largest possible answer.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>

<emptyline>
$\Large{\boxed{1} \quad \boxed{2} \quad \boxed{8} \quad \boxed{9}}$
<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The largest answer will only be possible when the two numbers are $91$ and $82$. So,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Largest possible product}  &= 91 \times 82 \\\\
                                  &= 7462
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A test to find whether a number is divisible by $9$ is to add up the digits. If the result is divisible by $9$ so is the original number.

For example, in the number $576$, the sum of the digits is $5 + 7 + 6 = 18$.

Since $18$ is exactly divisible by $9$, the number $576$ is also divisible by $9$.

On the other hand, in the number $1357$, the sum of the digits is $1 + 3 + 5 + 7 = 16$.

Since $16$ is not divisible by $9$, the number $1357$ is not divisible by $9$. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

**Question**

The five digit number $b6b51$ is divisible by $9$. What is the value of the $b \text{?}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The five digit number $b6b51$ is divisible by $9$. What is the value of the $b \text{?}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sum of digits}                          &= b + 6 + b + 5 + 1 \\\\
                                              &= 2b + 12
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2b + 12       &= 18 \\\\
2b            &= 18 - 12 \\\\
2b            &= 6 \\\\
b             &= \dfrac {6} {2} \\\\
b             &= \dfrac {2 \times 3} {2} \\\\
b             &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 3} {\cancel 2} \\\\
b             &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a Tennis club $\dfrac {1} {9}$ of the players are left handed.
                 
There are three times as many players who wear glasses as there are who are left handed. What fraction of the players wear glasses? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a Tennis club $\dfrac {1} {9}$ of the players are left handed.
<emptyline>
There are three times as many players who wear glasses as there are who are left handed. What fraction of the players wear glasses? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Fraction of players who wear glasses}      &= 3 \times \dfrac {1}{9} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {3 \times 1} {9} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {3 \times 1} {3 \times 3} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 1} {\cancel{3} \times 3} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {1} {3}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {3}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Boxes of eggs hold $12$ eggs. How many boxes will be needed to hold $158$ eggs? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total Box} &= \dfrac{158}{12} \\\\
                 &= \dfrac{79 \times 2}{6 \times 2} \\\\
                 &= \dfrac{79 \times \cancel 2}{6 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
                 &= \dfrac{79}{6} \\\\
                 &= 13 \text { remainder } 6 \\\\
                 &\approx 14
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

Gita wants to form a $4$ digit number where the first and last digits are both prime. What are the largest and smallest numbers that Gita can form?

Repeated digits are allowed. 

</div>

The smallest single digit prime number $= 2$

Largest 4 digit number $= 7997$

Smallest 4 digit number $= 2002$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A square number is what we get if we multiply a whole number by 
itself. A cube number comes from multiplying a number by itself and then by itself again. 
So $9$ is a square number because $9 = 3 \times 3$, and $8$ is a cube number because $8 = 2 \times 2 \times 2$.

$1$ is both a square and a cube because $1 = 1 \times 1$ and $1 = 1 \times 1 \times 1$. 
Find another number bigger than $0$ that is both a square and cube number.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A square number is what we get if we multiply a whole number by 
itself. A cube number comes from multiplying a number by itself and then by itself again. 
So $9$ is a square number because $9 = 3 \times 3$, and $8$ is a cube number because $8 = 2 \times 2 \times 2$.
<emptyline>
$1$ is both a square and a cube because $1 = 1 \times 1$ and $1 = 1 \times 1 \times 1$. 
Find another number bigger than $0$ that is both a square and cube number.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 8 \times 8 \\\\   
&= 8^2 \\\\
& = 64 \\\\
&= 4 \times 4 \times 4  \\\\
&= 4^3 \\\\   
& = 64 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

'Yummy' chocolate bars are packed in either boxes of $5$ or boxes of $12$.

What is the smallest number of full boxes required to pack exactly $2019$ 'Yummy' bars?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">'Yummy' chocolate bars are packed in either boxes of $5$ or boxes of $12$.
<emptyline>
What is the smallest number of full boxes required to pack exactly $2019$ 'Yummy' bars?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let number of $5$ size boxes $= a$

Let number of $12$ size boxes $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
5a + 12b              &= 2019 \\\\
5a                    &= 2019 - 12b \\\\
a                     &= \dfrac {2019 - 12b} {5}
\end{aligned}
$

For minimum number of boxes we need to have maximum number of $12$ size boxes.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Maximum number of 12 size boxes}    &= \dfrac {2019} {12} \\\\
                                          &= 168 \text{ remainder } 3 \\\\
                                          &\approx 168
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the value of a and b by trial and error.

|  Value of b  |      Value of $12b$       |  Value of $2019 - 12b$  |      Value a           |  Is value of a integer  |
|:------------:|:-------------------------:|:-----------------------:|:----------------------:|:-----------------------:|
|    $168$     |  $12 \times 168 = 2016$   |    $2019 - 2016 = 3$    |  $\dfrac {3} {5}$      |          No             |
|    $167$     |  $12 \times 167 = 2004$   |    $2019 - 2004 = 15$   |  $\dfrac {15} {5} = 3$ |          Yes            |

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Minimum number of boxes required}   &= a + b \\\\
                                          &= 3 + 167 \\\\
                                          &= 170
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$170$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On a farm $80$ sheep gave birth. $30\%$ of the sheep gave birth to two lambs. The rest of the sheep gave birth to one lamb. In total, how many lambs were born? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On a farm $80$ sheep gave birth. $30\%$ of the sheep gave birth to two lambs. The rest of the sheep gave birth to one lamb. In total, how many lambs were born? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Twins}          &= 30\% \ \text{of} \ 80 \\\\
                      &= \dfrac{30}{100}\times 80 \\\\
                      &= \dfrac{30 \times 80}{100} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac{3 \cancel 0 \times 8 \cancel 0}{1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                      &= 3 \times 8 \\\\
                      &= 24 \\\\
\text{Single}         &= 80-24 \\\\
                      &= 56 \\\\
\text{Total lambs}    &= 56 + 24 \times 2 \\\\
                      &= 56 + 48 \\\\
                      &= 104 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$104$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a tin of Roses, $8\%$ are “Purple Ones” (hazelnut & caramel). If the tin has a total of $250$ chocolates, how many are **not** Purple Ones?  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a tin of Roses, $8\%$ are “Purple Ones” (hazelnut & caramel). If the tin has a total of $250$ chocolates, how many are **not** Purple Ones?  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%

<div class="formula">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Not Purple}  &=  250 - 8 \% \times 250 \\\\
                    &=  250 - \dfrac {8} {100} \times 250 \\\\
                    &=  250 - \dfrac {2 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5 \times 10} {2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                    &=  250 - \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times 10} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                    &=  250 - 2 \times 10 \\\\
                    &=  250 - 20 \\\\
                    &=  230
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$230$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a tin of Quality Street, $12\%$ are Coffee Crèmes. If the tin has a total of $250$ chocolates, how many are not Coffee Crèmes?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a tin of Quality Street, $12\%$ are Coffee Crèmes. If the tin has a total of $250$ chocolates, how many are not Coffee Crèmes?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Not Coffee Crèmes}  &= 250 - 12 \ \% \ \text{of} \ 250 \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a giant tube of Fruit Pastilles, $20\%$ are orange. If the tube has a total of $85$ sweets, how many are **not** orange? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a giant tube of Fruit Pastilles, $20\%$ are orange. If the tube has a total of $85$ sweets, how many are **not** orange? 
</code></pre>

\begin{aligned}
\text {Not orange}  &= 85 - 20\% \times 85 \\\\
                    &= 85 - \dfrac {20} {100} \times 85 \\\\
                    &= 85 - \dfrac{2 \times 2 \times 5 \times 17 \times 5} {2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                    &= 85 - \dfrac{\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times 17 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\ 
                    &= 85 - 17 \\\\
                    &= 68
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Pippa came home from her holiday at her Grandma's with $5$ books. Whilst she was away she bought $2$ books from the bookshop and got $1$ book as a present from her Grandma. During her stay at her Grandma's she gave her cousin $4$ books that she had finished. How many books did Pippa take with her when she left for her holiday? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Pippa came home from her holiday at her Grandma's with $5$ books. Whilst she was away she bought $2$ books from the bookshop and got $1$ book as a present from her Grandma. During her stay at her Grandma's she gave her cousin $4$ books that she had finished. How many books did Pippa take with her when she left for her holiday? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of books Pipa took for holiday}   &= \text {Total books} - \text {Books given by Grandma} \\\\
                                                &= 5 + 2 + 1 + 4 - 2 - 1 \\\\
                                                &= 12 - 3 \\\\
                                                &= 9
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In 1990 a new $5 \ \text{p}$ coin was minted. The old size weighs $5.65\ \text{g}$ while the new size weighs $3.25\ \text{g}$. How much lighter will your pocket be if it contains $\pounds 2$ worth of the new size coins instead of the old size. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In 1990 a new $5 \ \text{p}$ coin was minted. The old size weighs $5.65\ \text{g}$ while the new size weighs $3.25\ \text{g}$. How much lighter will your pocket be if it contains $\pounds 2$ worth of the new size coins instead of the old size. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Old Weight}    &= \dfrac {2 \times 100}{5} \times 5.65 \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times 565 \times 100} {5 \times 100} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 113 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} {5 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 5 \times 113 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                      &= 226 \ \text {g} \\\\
\text {New Weight}    &= \dfrac{2 \times 100}{5} \times 3.25 \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times 325 \times 100} {5 \times 100} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 65 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} {5 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 5 \times 65 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                      &= 130 \ \text {g} \\\\
\text{Difference}     &= 226 - 130 \\\\
                      &= 96 \ \text{g}                                  
\end{aligned}
$

Pocket will be $96 \ \text{g}$ lighter.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$96 \ \text{g}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Old Weight}    &= \dfrac {2 \times 100}{5} \times 5.65 \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times 565 \times 100} {5 \times 100} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 113 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} {5 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 5 \times 113 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                      &= 226 \ \text {g} \\\\
\text {New Weight}    &= \dfrac{2 \times 100}{5} \times 3.25 \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times 325 \times 100} {5 \times 100} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 65 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} {5 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 5 \times 65 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                      &= 130 \ \text {g} \\\\
\text{Difference}     &= 226 - 130 \\\\
                      &= 96 \ \text{g}                                  
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Pocket will be $96 \ \text{g}$ lighter.
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a box of sweets there are $7$ toffees for every $12$ chocolates. If there are $72$ chocolates how many toffees are there? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a box of sweets there are $7$ toffees for every $12$ chocolates. If there are $72$ chocolates how many toffees are there? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of toffees $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
12 \ \text{chocolates} : 7 \ \text{toffees}     &= 72 \ \text{chocolates} : a \ \text{toffees} \\\\
\dfrac {12} {7}                                 &= \dfrac {72} {a} \\\\
12 \times a                                     &= 72 \times 7 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {72 \times 7} {12} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {6 \times 12 \times 7} {12} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {6 \times \cancel {12} \times 7} {\cancel {12}} \\\\
a                                               &= 6 \times 7 \\\\
a                                               &= 42
\end{aligned}
$

Number of toffees $= 42$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{chocolates}             &:& \text{toffees} \\\\
= & 12                            &:& 7 \\\\
= & 12 \times 6                   &:& 7 \times 6 \\\\
= & 72                            &:& 42
\end{array}
$

Number of toffees $= 42$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$42$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jennifer is assembling a wardrobe. The measurements for the $3$ sections are given in different units. 
The first section is $30 \ \text{cm}$ wide; the second section is $1.5 \ \text{m}$ wide and 
the third section $150 \ \text{mm}$ wide. How wide is whole wardrobe? Give your answer in $\text{cm}$. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jennifer is assembling a wardrobe. The measurements for the $3$ sections are given in different units. 
The first section is $30 \ \text{cm}$ wide; the second section is $1.5 \ \text{m}$ wide and 
the third section $150 \ \text{mm}$ wide. How wide is whole wardrobe? Give your answer in $\text{cm}$. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total width}    &= 30 \ \text{cm} + 1.5 \ \text{m} + 150 \ \text{mm} \\\\
                      &= 30 \ \text{cm} + 1.5 \times 10 \ \text{cm} + \dfrac{150}{10}\ \text{cm} \\\\
                      &= 30 + 15 + \dfrac{15 \times 2 \times 5}{2 \times 5} \\\\
                      &= 30 + 15 + \dfrac{15 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5}{\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                      &= 60 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$60 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Kevin gets paid $\pounds 500$ for each match he plays plus $\pounds 100$ for each goal he scores. In a season he plays $20$ games and averages two goals per game.
How much does he earn over the season?  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Kevin gets paid $\pounds 500$ for each match he plays plus $\pounds 100$ for each goal he scores. In a season he plays $20$ games and averages two goals per game.
How much does he earn over the season?  
</code></pre>

                        &= 20 \times 500 + 2 \times 20 \times 100 \\\\
                        &= 10000 + 4000 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 14000
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If she started with $\pounds 120$ how much does she have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If she started with $\pounds 120$ how much does she have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money left}         &= \text{Total money} - \text{Money spent on dress} - \text{Money spent on shoes} \\\\
                          &= 120 - \left( \dfrac {1}{3} \times \dfrac{1}{2} \times 120 \right) - \left( \dfrac{1}{2} \times 120 \right) \\\\
                          &= 120 - \left( \dfrac {1}{3} \times \dfrac{1}{2} \times 3 \times 2 \times 20 \right) - \left( \dfrac{1}{2} \times 2 \times 60 \right) \\\\
                          &= 120 - \left( \dfrac {1}{\cancel 3} \times \dfrac{1}{\cancel 2} \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 2 \times 20 \right) - \left( \dfrac{1}{\cancel 2} \times \cancel 2 \times 60 \right) \\\\
                          &= 120 - (60 + 20) \\\\
                          &= 120 - 80 \\\\
                          &= \pounds 40
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 40$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A box contains $220$ matches and weighs 
$45 \ \text{grams}$. 

The empty box weighs $12 \ \text{grams}$.

Calculate the weight of one match.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A box contains $220$ matches and weighs 
$45 \ \text{grams}$. 
<emptyline>
The empty box weighs $12 \ \text{grams}$.
<emptyline>
Calculate the weight of one match.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Weight of one match}      &= \dfrac {45 - 12} {220} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {33} {220} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {3 \times 11} {2 \times 10 \times 11} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel{11}} {2 \times 10 \times \cancel{11}} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {3} {2 \times 10} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {3} {20} \\\\
                                 &= 0.15 \ \text{grams} 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$0.15 \ \text{grams}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$70$ children need $3$ pens each.

Pens are sold in packs of $8$.

How many packs of pens need to be bought?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$70$ children need $3$ pens each.
<emptyline>
Pens are sold in packs of $8$.
<emptyline>
How many packs of pens need to be bought?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Pack of pens need to be bought}         &= \dfrac {3 \times 70} {8} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {3 \times 35 \times 2} {4 \times 2} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {3 \times 35 \times \cancel{2}} {4 \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {3 \times 35} {4} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {105} {4} \\\\
                                              &= 26 \text{ remainder } 1 \\\\
                                              &\approx 27
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$27$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The cost for using a minibus is $\pounds 2.42$ for each kilometre.

$11$ friends go on a $32 \ \text{kilometre}$ journey using $1$ minibus.

They share the cost equally.

How much does each person pay?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The cost for using a minibus is $\pounds 2.42$ for each kilometre.
<emptyline>
$11$ friends go on a $32 \ \text{kilometre}$ journey using $1$ minibus.
<emptyline>
They share the cost equally.
<emptyline>
How much does each person pay?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost per person}      &= \dfrac {2.42 \times 32} {11} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {2.42 \times 100 \times 32} {11 \times 100} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {242 \times 32} {11 \times 100} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {11 \times \cancel {11} \times 2 \times 32} {\cancel {11} \times 100} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {11 \times 2 \times 32} {100} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {704} {100} \\\\
                             &= \pounds 7.04
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 7.04$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sarah won a large jar of sweets in a Christmas raffle. If there are $486$ sweets in the jar and she shares them equally with her $17$ classmates, how many do they each get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sarah won a large jar of sweets in a Christmas raffle. If there are $486$ sweets in the jar and she shares them equally with her $17$ classmates, how many do they each get?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Sweets per person}       &= \dfrac {486} {18} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {27 \times 18}{18} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {27 \times 2 \times 3 \times 3}{2 \times 3 \times 3} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {27 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 3}{\cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
                                &= 27
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$27$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A box of biscuits contains $36$ biscuits. $20$ biscuits have foil wrappers. $15$ are chocolate biscuits with foil wrappers. 
If $9$ are not chocolate and do not have a foil wrapper, then how many chocolate biscuits are there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A box of biscuits contains $36$ biscuits. $20$ biscuits have foil wrappers. $15$ are chocolate biscuits with foil wrappers. 
If $9$ are not chocolate and do not have a foil wrapper, then how many chocolate biscuits are there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of chocolate biscuits without foil wrappers}  &= 36 - 20 - 9 \\\\
                                                            &= 16 - 9 \\\\
                                                            &= 7 \\\\
\text {Total chocolate biscuits}                            &= 15 + 7 \\\\
                                                            &= 22
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$22$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$75$ students need $3$ pens each. Pens are sold in packs of $6$. How many whole packs need to be bought?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$75$ students need $3$ pens each. Pens are sold in packs of $6$. How many whole packs need to be bought?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total packs needed}       &= \dfrac{\text{Total pens required}}{\text{Pens per pack}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{75 \times 3}{6} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{75 \times 3}{2 \times 3} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{75 \times \cancel{3}}{2 \times \cancel{3}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{75}{2} \\\\
                                &= 37 \ \text {remainder} \ 1 \\\\
                                &\approx 38
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$38$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

You are told that $56\%$ of the pupils in a class are girls. 

What is the smallest number of pupils the class could contain?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">You are told that $56\%$ of the pupils in a class are girls. 
<emptyline>
What is the smallest number of pupils the class could contain?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The smallest number of pupils the class could contain can be found by writing the fraction in its simplest form.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Percentage of girls}          &= 56 \ \% \\\\
\text{Percentage of boys}           &= 100 - 56 \\\\
                                    &= 44 \ \% \\\\
\text{Ratio}                        &= \dfrac {44} {56} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {4 \times 11} {4 \times 14} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 11} {\cancel 4 \times 14} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {11} {14} \\\\
\text{Smallest number of pupils}    &= 11 + 14 \\\\
                                    &= 25
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$25$

</div>
</div>

                                    &= 44 \ \% \\\\
\text{Ratio}                        &= \dfrac {44} {56} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {4 \times 11} {4 \times 14} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 11} {\cancel 4 \times 14} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {11} {14} \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sam and Alice have baked a cake.

Sam eats $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of the cake.

Alice eats $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the cake.

What fraction of the cake have they eaten altogether? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sam and Alice have baked a cake.
<emptyline>
Sam eats $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of the cake.
<emptyline>
Alice eats $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the cake.
<emptyline>
What fraction of the cake have they eaten altogether? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of cake eaten together}    &=  \dfrac{1}{4} + \dfrac{2}{5} \\\\
                                          &=  \dfrac{1 \times 5}{4  \times 5} + \dfrac{2 \times 4}{5 \times 4} \\\\
                                          &=  \dfrac{5}{20} + \dfrac{8}{20} \\\\
                                          &=  \dfrac{5 + 8} {20} \\\\
                                          &=  \dfrac{13}{20}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac{13}{20}$

</div>
</div>

$1 \ \text{hour}$ and $45 \ \text{minutes}$ to walk down.

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In the number $267{,}865$ how many times bigger is the value of the first digit $6$ than the value of the second digit $6?$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the number $267{,}865$ how many times bigger is the value of the first digit $6$ than the value of the second digit $6?$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac{60,000}{60} \\\\
&= \dfrac{60 \times 1000} {60} \\\\
&= \dfrac{2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 5 \times 1000} {2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac{\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 5 \times 1000} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
&= 1000
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sixteen people, and no more, can sit evenly spaced around a large square table. 
Jas arranges six of these square tables in a row to make one long rectangular table. 
What is the maximum number of people that can sit evenly  spaced around this long table?

- $46$
- $76$
- $56$
- $96$
- $86$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sixteen people, and no more, can sit evenly spaced around a large square table. 
Jas arranges six of these square tables in a row to make one long rectangular table. 
What is the maximum number of people that can sit evenly  spaced around this long table?
<emptyline>
- $46$
- $76$
- $56$
- $96$
- $86$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number people one side of the square table}      &= \dfrac {\text {Total people}} {\text {Number of sides}} \\\\
                                                        &= \dfrac {16} {4} \\\\
                                                        &= 4 \\\\
\text {Maximum number of people in rectangular table}   &= \text {Total square tables} \times \text {People per table} - \text {Number of seats lost} \\\\
                                                        &= 6 \times 16 - 10 \times 4 \\\\
                                                        &= 96 - 40 \\\\
                                                        &= 56
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$56$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jan counted a total of $100$ cars parked in four rows of a departmental store car park. 
Five minutes later, $10$ cars had driven away from the first row, 
$8$ cars had driven away from the second row, 
$6$ cars had driven away from the third row and 
$4$ cars had driven away from the fourth row. 
She noticed that there was now the same number of cars in each row. 
How many cars were originally parked in the third row? 

- $24$
- $19$
- $25$
- $18$
- $23$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jan counted a total of $100$ cars parked in four rows of a departmental store car park. 
Five minutes later, $10$ cars had driven away from the first row, 
$8$ cars had driven away from the second row, 
$6$ cars had driven away from the third row and 
$4$ cars had driven away from the fourth row. 
She noticed that there was now the same number of cars in each row. 
How many cars were originally parked in the third row? 
<emptyline>
- $24$
- $19$
- $25$
- $18$
- $23$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of cars parked in each row after the cars drived away $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(a + 10) + (a + 8) + (a + 6) + (a + 4)          &= 100 \\\\
a + 10 + a + 8 + a + 6 + a + 4                  &= 100 \\\\
4a + 28                                         &= 100 \\\\
4a                                              &= 100 - 28 \\\\
4a                                              &= 72 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {72} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {4 \times 18} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 18} {\cancel 4} \\\\
a                                               &= 18
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of cars parked in 3rd row originally}    &= a + 6 \\\\
                                                      &= 18 + 6 \\\\
                                                      &= 24
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Option**

<p>A</p>
</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$24$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The Crystal Palace bridge has carried $300 \ \text{million}$ cars since it was opened in $1964$. 
On average, roughly how many vehicles is this per month?

- $50000$
- $500000$
- $5000000$
- $6000000$
- $60000000$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The Crystal Palace bridge has carried $300 \ \text{million}$ cars since it was opened in $1964$. 
On average, roughly how many vehicles is this per month?
<emptyline>
- $50000$
- $500000$
- $5000000$
- $6000000$
- $60000000$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of vehicles per month}       &= \dfrac {300 \ \text{million}} {(2022 - 1964) \times 12} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {300 \times 1000000} {58 \times 12} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {300000000} {696} \\\\
                                          &= 431034.4328 \\\\
                                          &\approx 500000
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Answer**

$500000$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A cube with sides $3 \ \text{cm}$ is made from smaller cubes of side $1 \ \text{cm}$ as shown.

![papers/streatham-and-clapham-high-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q09-i00.png](/assets/papers/streatham-and-clapham-high-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q09-i00.png "papers/streatham-and-clapham-high-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q09-i00.png")

How many small cubes are used in making the bigger cube?

- $21$
- $27$
- $9$
- $18$
- $30$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A bus has $35$ passengers on board. At the first stop two-fifths get off and then $7$ people get on. 
At the next stop a quarter of the people remaining on the bus get off and then $13$ get on. 
How many passengers are there on the bus now?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A bus has $35$ passengers on board. At the first stop two-fifths get off and then $7$ people get on. 
At the next stop a quarter of the people remaining on the bus get off and then $13$ get on. 
How many passengers are there on the bus now?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total passengers after 1st stop}          &= 35 - \bigg({\dfrac {2}{5}} \ \text {of} \ 35 \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2} {5} \times 35 \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times 35} {5} \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 7} {5} \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times \cancel {5} \times 7} {\cancel {5}} \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - (2 \times 7) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - 14 + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 28 \ \text {passengers} \\\\
\text{Total passengers after 2nd stop}          &= 28 - \bigg({\dfrac {1}{4}} \ \text {of} \ 28 \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {4} \times 28 \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {4} \times 4 \times 7 \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {4 \times 7} {4} \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {\cancel {4} \times 7} {\cancel {4} } \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - 7 + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 34 \ \text {passengers}
\end{aligned}
$

There are $34$ passengers on the bus now.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$34$

</div>
</div>

<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>

</code></pre>

<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

</div>

</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total passengers after 1st stop}          &= 35 - \bigg({\dfrac {2}{5}} \ \text {of} \ 35 \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2} {5} \times 35 \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times 35} {5} \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 7} {5} \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times \cancel {5} \times 7} {\cancel {5}} \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - (2 \times 7) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - 14 + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 28 \ \text {passengers} \\\\
\text{Total passengers after 2nd stop}          &= 28 - \bigg({\dfrac {1}{4}} \ \text {of} \ 28 \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {4} \times 28 \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {4} \times 4 \times 7 \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {4 \times 7} {4} \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {\cancel {4} \times 7} {\cancel {4} } \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - 7 + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 34 \ \text {passengers}
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
There are $34$ passengers on the bus now.
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

TODOTABLE

**Question**

Josephine currently weighs $53 \ \text{kg}$. She has a $BMI$ of $16$ so is currently classified as underweight. 
What is the least extra weight that she needs to put on if she is to be re-classified as normal?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Josephine currently weighs $53 \ \text{kg}$. She has a $BMI$ of $16$ so is currently classified as underweight. 
What is the least extra weight that she needs to put on if she is to be re-classified as normal?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$BMI$ $18.5$ or less is classified as $Underweight$. 

Refer to the calculations at the end of the question.

$\dfrac{53}{1.82^2} = 16$

and 

$\dfrac{61.6}{1.82^2} = 18.6$

$BMI$ between $18.6$ and $24.9$ is classified as $Normal$.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Lowest weight Josephine need to put on} &= 61.6 - 53 \\\\
                                               &= 8.6 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $161$ sweets are shared equally between $7$ people, how many sweets does each person receive?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $161$ sweets are shared equally between $7$ people, how many sweets does each person receive?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Sweets each person get}      &= \dfrac {\text{Total sweets}} {\text{Total people}} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {161} {7} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {7 \times 23}{7} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel 7 \times 23} {\cancel 7} \\\\
                                    &= 23
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$23$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $9$ bananas cost $\pounds 1.23$ find the cost of $12$ bananas.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $9$ bananas cost $\pounds 1.23$ find the cost of $12$ bananas.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total cost}       &= 12 \times \dfrac{1.23}{9} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{12 \times 1.23 }{9} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{3 \times 4 \times 0.41 \times 3}{3 \times 3} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{\cancel{3} \times 4 \times 0.41 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel{3} \times \cancel{3}} \\\\
                        &= 4 \times 0.41 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 1.64
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.64$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

When a rope is cut equally into $8$ pieces it is discovered that each piece is a whole number of centimetres long. 
The same thing happens if this rope is cut into $6$ pieces. What is the shortest length that this rope could be?

</div>

</code></pre>

**Working**

This can be solved by finding the LCM of $8$ and $6$

Let's first find the LCM of $8$ and $6$ by listing multiples. The smallest number that is a multiple of two numbers is the LCM

Multiple of $8 = 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, \ldots$

Multiple of $6 = 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, \ldots$

The LCM of $8$ and $6$ is the smallest number that is a multiple of both numbers $=24$.

The shortest length that this rope could be $= 24 \ \text{cm}$
</div>

**Question**

 The table below shows the prices of a week's holiday at four
hotels in Orlando Florida during October this year. The prices are per person
and a reduction is offered for **children aged $2$ to $16 \ \text{years}$ old**. The
prices include the cost of the flight and accommodation. **Infants under $2 \ \text{years}$ old travel free**. There is an option to buy tickets to the theme
parks. Infants have free entry.

For example, if a family consisting of two adults and one child (aged $9$) 
stay for a week at the Little Rodent Hotel the total cost of the holiday, 
including a rover theme park ticket for everyone, would be:

$2 \times 1320 + 780 + 2 \times 320 + 240 = \pounds 4300$

|      Hotel     |  Cost per adult  |  Cost per child  |  Adult Rover Ticket | Child Rover Ticket |
|:--------------:|:----------------:|:----------------:|:-------------------:|:------------------:|
|  Little Rodent | $\pounds  1320 $ |  $\pounds  780 $ |   $\pounds  320 $   |   $\pounds  240 $  |
|   South Seas   | $\pounds  1450 $ |  $\pounds  850 $ |   $\pounds  320 $   |   $\pounds  240 $  |
|  Holiday Mill  | $\pounds  1550 $ |  $\pounds  900 $ |   $\pounds  320 $   |   $\pounds  240 $  |
| Portomento Bay | $\pounds  2050 $ | $\pounds  1040 $ |   $\pounds  320 $   |   $\pounds  240 $  |

the Holiday Mill for a week, including the cost of rover theme park tickets.

</div>

**Question**

A family consisting of just one adult and a child (aged $11$) decide to spend a week in Orlando. They are 
trying to choose between staying at the South Seas and Portomento Bay. How much more expensive will it be 
to stay at the Portomento Bay?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A family consisting of just one adult and a child (aged $11$) decide to spend a week in Orlando. They are 
trying to choose between staying at the South Seas and Portomento Bay. How much more expensive will it be 
to stay at the Portomento Bay?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$ 
\begin{aligned} 
\text{Difference}       &= \text {Portomento Bay} - \text{South Seas} \\\\
                        &= (2050 + 1040) - (1450 + 850) \\\\               
                        &= 3090 - 2300 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 790
\end{aligned}
$

The Portomento Bay will be $\pounds 790$ more expensive.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 790 $
